generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a broadleaf evergreen with a leaning, crooked trunk, an irregular crown, thick, glossy oval leaves and clusters of small white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 16 m tall and 40 cm across at breast height at 50 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: glossy dark green leaves; smooth, peeling orange-red bark. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: drooping panicles of pebbly berries about 1 cm across, still yellow-green, a few turning orange. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: white urn-shaped flowers in April and May; berries green in summer, orange-red from October, eaten into the winter. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): red-brown bark peeling in thin papery flakes from smooth greenish-tan inner bark; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
